# UX & Rendering Quality Checklist: Multi-Image Slideshow

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, completeness, clarity, and consistency for the multi-image slideshow feature  
**Created**: 2026-11-04  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the default image count (10) and permissible range (2 to 50) explicitly defined for multi-image mode? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are interactive controls specified for both toggling multi-image mode and incrementing/decrementing slide count? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements documented for individual image replacement and removal within the multi-image curation modal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements specified for re-rolling the entire multi-image selection in a single action? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for state persistence across queue refreshes and browser page reloads? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK006 Is the transition animation between sequential slides quantified with direction (right-to-left) and duration (0.6s–0.8s)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Is per-slide duration mathematically defined relative to total video duration and image count ($D / N$)? [Clarity, Spec §US2/AC1]
- [ ] CHK008 Are image aspect-ratio scaling rules (1080x1920 center-crop/matte, 20% background dimming) explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the behavior of text and logo overlays during slide transitions explicitly documented as steady and uninterrupted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Consistency & Architecture Alignment

- [ ] CHK010 Do multi-image configuration requirements align with the existing `QueueItem` schema without breaking single-image workflows? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK011 Are 9:16 vertical formatting requirements consistent with Constitution Principle II? [Consistency, Constitution II]
- [ ] CHK012 Are decoupled service boundaries maintained between `QueueService`, `SlideshowService`, and `render_pipeline` per Constitution Principle I? [Consistency, Constitution I]

## Edge Cases & Boundary Handling

- [ ] CHK013 Is fallback behavior defined when the source folder contains fewer images than the requested count? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are transition duration clamping rules specified for very short videos with high image counts to prevent overlap collisions? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Is behavior documented for single-image folders where multi-image mode cannot be populated? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Are resource cleanup requirements specified for intermediate video clips to prevent memory leaks on Windows? [Edge Cases, Constitution III]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CHK017 Can the 3-second toggle and count adjustment target be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK018 Can the absence of frame freezes, black flashes, and audio desynchronization be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the 100% output resolution verification criterion defined without ambiguous phrasing? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001 - CHK019) for traceability
